item.creature_translator.desc: Right-click a wild creature to read its mood and what it wants. Respond the right way — bait, calm, approach or give space — to earn its trust and tame it. Costs suit energy.

item.forage_bait.desc: A bundle of plant matter that herbivorous creatures love. Used while taming.
item.meat_bait.name: Meat Bait
item.meat_bait.desc: A strip of fresh meat that lures carnivorous creatures. Used while taming.
item.nectar_lure.name: Nectar Lure
item.nectar_lure.desc: A sweet, salty lure that tempts gentle grazers. Used while taming.
item.camera.name: Camera
item.camera.desc: Right-click to photograph your view (without the HUD). Photos are saved to disk and can be browsed — and annotated — in the Photos tab of the menu.

blueprint.refinery.name: Refinery
blueprint.refinery.desc: Unlocks the refinery module for processing ores.
blueprint.detoxifier.name: Detoxifier
blueprint.detoxifier.desc: Unlocks the detoxifier module that turns poison into safe food.
blueprint.matter_forge.name: Matter Forge
blueprint.matter_forge.desc: Unlocks the transmuter — salvaged matter-reassembly tech that compacts spare sand, soil and stone into matter dust and synthesises it back into common ores.
blueprint.matter_resynth.name: Matter Resynthesis
blueprint.matter_resynth.desc: Extends the transmuter to resynthesise matter dust into select mid-tier ores. Always costlier than mining them.
blueprint.tractor_beam.name: Tractor Beam

ui.beam.none: No other reachable beam blocks on this world yet.
vega.intro.1: Emergency reactivation complete. VEGA online — Vectored Exploration and Guidance Array, at your service. Mostly intact. Which is more than I can say for my memory banks.
vega.intro.2: Status: one pilot, one ship, one planet of unknown temperament. Let's cover the basics before something covers them for us.
vega.resume: Resuming guidance protocol. We were in the middle of something — remember?
vega.veteran: VEGA online. Systems nominal. You clearly know what you're doing — I'll keep quiet until it gets interesting.
vega.skip: Understood. Tutorial protocols archived. Try not to make me regret this.
vega.done: Guidance protocol complete: you mine, craft, research, fly, trade and land. Officially a spacefarer. One more thing — old ruins and wrecks sometimes hold fragments of my memory. I'd like those back.
vega.s.mine.start: First: resources. Your drill sits in slot 1 — point it at the ground and hold. Mine a few blocks. Any blocks. The planet won't mind.
vega.s.mine.done: Adequate drilling technique. That's the foundation of everything out here. One tip: the metals you'll need — iron first — sit just a few blocks underground, so dig down, not just across.
vega.s.craft.start: Now turn rubble into tools: open the menu (Tab), Crafting tab, make anything. I recommend something useful.
vega.s.craft.done: Crafted. See? Industry. I'm almost proud.
vega.s.eat.start: Survival basics: don't starve. Smash the green plants around you — they drop berries. Open your pack (Tab) and eat one. Hunted creatures drop meat too, which fills you more.
vega.s.eat.done: Fed. Out here your stomach is a clock you have to wind. Keep spare food in the suit's ration dispenser and it feeds you automatically before you keel over.
vega.s.scan.start: Knowledge is currency. Equip the hand scanner (slot 3) and scan something — flora, rocks, wildlife. Preferably before it bites.
vega.s.scan.done: Scan archived, knowledge gained. That's what pays for your blueprints.
vega.s.unlock.start: Spend that knowledge: open the Tech tab and research your first blueprint. The cheap one is fine. Growth mindset.
vega.s.unlock.done: Blueprint unlocked. Engineering would weep with joy — if we still had an Engineering.
vega.s.launch.start: Time to fly. Board the ship and launch into space. The helm handles the hard part. The hard part is me, technically.
vega.s.dock.start: See the station on the radar? Dock there. Stations mean traders, jobs, and people who aren't me.
vega.s.dock.done: Docked. Mind the locals — they're mostly harmless.
vega.s.trade.start: Commerce time: barter with a vendor or take a job from the mission board. Either keeps the lights on.
vega.s.trade.done: Transaction logged. A working economy, and we're in it.
vega.s.land.start: Last lesson: pick a world on the star map and land on it. Any world — they're all round now, I checked.
vega.s.land.done: Touchdown. That's the whole loop: mine, build, learn, fly, trade, land.
vega.hint.breathe: The air here is breathable — see your oxygen bar sitting full? Enjoy it. In space, underwater, or on a toxic world your suit tank drains, and the ship or a station is what refills it.
vega.hint.o2: Oxygen below 25%. The ship and stations refill it. Suffocation, notably, does not.
vega.hint.energy: Suit energy low. It recharges aboard the ship — the jetpack and gadgets are what's draining it.
vega.hint.hunger: Your stomach is filing complaints. Smash green flora for berries or hunt creatures for meat — or load rations into the suit dispenser, it feeds you automatically.
vega.hint.shipfood: Aboard, life support refills your hunger — but slowly, on purpose. Eating berries or meat is far quicker, so don't rely on the ship alone to keep you fed.
vega.hint.invfull: Inventory full. Stow things in the ship's cargo hold — or admit you don't need nine kinds of rock.
vega.hint.night: Night falls. The local fauna gets bold in the dark. Your suit lamp is on L.
vega.hint.poi: Structural echoes nearby — ruins or wreckage. Worth a look. Bring the scanner.
vega.hint.world.asteroid: An asteroid: low gravity, no air, deep craters. The rare metals like the deep ones.
vega.hint.world.ocean: Ocean world. Land is the rare resource here. Try not to park in the surf.
vega.hint.world.corrupted: This world reads… wrong. My sensors itch. The floating landmasses are not my doing.
vega.hint.world.fungal: A fungal world. The mushrooms are building-sized. The spores are mostly harmless. Mostly.
vega.hint.world.ice: Ice world. Beautiful, lethal, slippery — the classic trio.
vega.hint.world.volcanic: Volcanic activity everywhere. The ground bites here — watch for vents and lava.
vega.mem.1: A memory fragment… reading. — I was not built for one pilot. I was the navigation core of a survey fleet. The Meridian. …Thank you for this.
vega.mem.2: Another shard. Forty ships. We charted these systems before anyone had names for them. Half the routes you fly are mine.
vega.mem.3: This one is corrupted at the edges. A recall order — the fleet was called home. We never went.
vega.mem.4: I remember a sister core: ECHO, escort wing. Her humour was worse than mine. I still listen for her on the long bands.
vega.mem.5: A cargo manifest. Vault seeds. We BUILT the buried vaults — supply caches for a return that never came.
vega.mem.6: Coordinates… the corrupted worlds. We were sent to study them. The readings in this fragment are still screaming.
vega.mem.7: A casualty log. The corruption wasn't weather. It moved. The fleet scattered — that is why the wrecks lie where they lie.
vega.mem.8: My own ship. The Long Now. Scuttled by my own captain — to keep something out of my core. I had wondered why I woke up… edited.
vega.mem.9: The last order: 'Preserve the charts. Wait for a pilot.' That would be you. The wait is logged at 312 years.
vega.mem.10: The final fragment — my core schematics, complete. I remember everything now. Take the plans: build me back to what I was. And… thank you, pilot.
vega.mem.more: Another fragment — archive noise, old star charts. Comforting, in a filing-cabinet way.
vega.sys.mk2: Mk2 core online. Scanner uplink active — wider terrain pulses, and I'll call out hostiles in space.
vega.sys.mk3: Mk3 core online. I now have flight authority for evasive manoeuvres. Try to look surprised when I save us.
vega.sys.mk3bp: Core schematics restored — the AI Core Mk3 blueprint is in your tech archive. Build it when you're ready.
vega.sys.spotted: Heads up — a hostile has us on its scope and is closing in.
vega.brief.bandits: One thing you should know out here, pilot: bandits. Scoundrels who stop travelers and demand a share of their cargo. If one hails you, you have a real choice — hand something over and they leave you alone, or refuse and they'll fight. Nothing shameful about paying; nothing wrong with standing your ground either. They never bother anyone with empty pockets.
vega.sys.bandit_sector: Heads up — this sector has a reputation for bandit activity. Keep your scope warm.
vega.sys.bandit_hail: Incoming hail… it's a bandit demand. Your call, pilot — pay them off or refuse and fight.
vega.sys.bandit_region: My scans flag robber activity on this world. If a stranger walks straight at you, remember: pay or fight — your choice.
vega.sys.bandit_camp_near: I'm reading a bandit camp on this world. Its guards attack on sight — but their stash would make a fine prize.
ui.vega.name: VEGA
ui.reminder.break: You've been out here a good while now. Remember — there's a real world too. Maybe a short break?
ui.reminder.break.again: Still going? The stars won't run away. Stand up for a moment, drink something.
ui.reminder.break.long: It's gotten really late. Go ahead and save and get some rest — I'll watch the ship.

ui.worldopt.advanced_note: Touched rows override the world's planet mix completely (◆ = exotic type). Reset returns to the data weights + the exotic slider.
ui.worldopt.structures_note: How readily authored station/town templates (from the editors) appear in place of procedurally generated ones. Off = always procedural.
ui.worldopt.packs_none: No template packs installed yet. Build stations/towns in the editors to add some.
planet.rocky.desc: A dusty, cratered world of mesas and bare stone under a thin toxic haze. Mild and quiet, with little life. Surface metals come easy — iron, copper, aluminium and lead sit near the top, with gold and silver a little deeper. A gentle place to learn the ropes and stock up on basic ores.
planet.ice.desc: A frozen, toxic world locked far below zero. Glassy ice sheets cover the stone and flora barely clings on. Good hunting for cobalt and nickel, with silver and zinc in the shallows and titanium deep down — bring a Tier-2 drill. Wildlife is scarce.
planet.lava.desc: A blistering volcanic world of basalt fields and open lava, wrapped in toxic air and sudden storms. Harsh — but the deep rock is a treasure vault: uranium, platinum, tungsten and diamond all lie far below, with titanium and sulfur higher up. Mind your footing and your oxygen.
planet.desert.desc: Endless toxic dunes baked under a hot sun, swept by the odd sandstorm and bone-dry — no surface water here. Lithium and sulfur are the prize, alongside gold, aluminium and plentiful silicate. Carry spare oxygen and water before you cross the sands.
planet.jungle.desc: A warm, breathable green world drenched in frequent rain and bursting with life — dense flora and many creatures. No suit oxygen needed, so it's a favourite for settling. Tin, zinc, iron and copper run through the hills. Watch the storms and the wildlife's moods.
planet.crystal.desc: An airless world of glittering spires under a clear, silent sky — beautiful and lethal, so bring your own oxygen. The deep stone hides a rare-metal hoard: titanium, cobalt, neodymium, uranium, tungsten and diamond, plus crystal at the surface. Data caches turn up unusually often here.
planet.swamp.desc: A muddy, overcast world under thick, breathable air, often wet with rain and busy with creatures. Easy to live on. Tin, zinc, lead and sulfur reward digging, with copper and carbon throughout. The ground is soft — mind the bogs.
planet.varied.desc: A temperate, breathable world that blends grassland, sand, stone and bog into one — every world of this type reads differently. Balanced and lively. A dependable spread of iron, copper, aluminium, tin, lithium and carbon makes it a solid all-round home base.
planet.ocean.desc: A breathable blue world where wide seas cover most of the land and storms roll in often. Bring a way to breathe and move underwater. Iron, copper, tin and aluminium line the seabeds and islands; carbon runs below. Rich in life.
planet.savanna.desc: Warm, breathable grassland dotted with lone trees under big dry skies — easy to settle and full of creatures. Gold and lithium join the usual iron, copper and aluminium. The long sightlines make it good for spotting settlements and landed traders.
planet.highland.desc: A breathable world of soaring stone mountains and deep valleys, swept by mountain storms. Climbing pays off: iron, copper, silver, nickel, cobalt and titanium abound, and diamond waits in the deepest roots. Steep ground — a jetpack earns its keep.
planet.crystal_living.desc: A cold, exotic world where crystalline growths sheathe the spires and a toxic haze hangs low — an oxygen extractor helps. The motherlode of crystal, with titanium, cobalt, neodymium and diamond beneath. Strange and quiet; data caches run rich.
planet.ashen.desc: A scorched, exotic world of grey ash over basalt, with lava pooling in the lowlands and hot, toxic air above. Brutal to cross but rich: platinum, tungsten, titanium and diamond reward the deep digger, with sulfur and iron up top.
planet.tundra.desc: A cold but breathable world of snowfields and low hills, often caught in snowstorms. Livable with the right gear. Iron, copper, nickel, cobalt and silver lie under the white. Sparse trees and shy wildlife.
planet.fungal.desc: An exotic, toxic world carpeted in mycelium and giant fungi, dim under heavy cloud and teeming with creatures. An extractor eases the air. The ore is ordinary — tin, zinc, lead, copper, iron — but the strange biology and frequent data caches make it worth the trip.
planet.corrupted.desc: An exotic, toxic world of alien grass and broken canyons, with chunks of land drifting in the sky. Eerie and lively. Uranium, neodymium and diamond hide deep, with lithium and sulfur about. An extractor and steady nerves help.
planet.salt_flats.desc: A glaring, exotic world of cracked salt pans under a clear toxic sky — flat, dry and waterless. Lithium sits unusually shallow here, with sulfur, gold and aluminium alongside. Easy to cross; pack water and oxygen.
planet.skylands.desc: A rare, breathable world where great islands of land float high among the clouds. Lush and full of life. Iron, copper, tin and gold run through the floating rock — a jetpack or speeder makes island-hopping a joy.
planet.tablelands.desc: A breathable world of monumental stone terraces — vast flat-topped mesas stacked like giant stairs, their escarpment cliffs dropping to sandy canyon floors. Grass crowns the high tables; gold and titanium hide in the rock. Bring a jetpack for the cliffs.
planet.badlands.desc: A scorched maze of sharp painted ridges and eroded gullies under a toxic haze. Hard to cross on foot, but the folded rock bares its riches: copper, iron, gold — and uranium in the deep roots. Watch your oxygen.
planet.karst.desc: A humid, breathable world where sheer stone towers rise from rolling green jungle floors, their flat crowns walkable high above the canopy. Rich in life; silver and lithium vein the towers. Rain is frequent — and the view from a crown unforgettable.
planet.asteroid.desc: A barren, airless rock adrift in space, pocked with craters and silent as the void. No life, no weather — just grey stone, dark basalt and drifts of dust. Iron, silicate, copper and tin lie shallow, with gold and cobalt deeper down. The workhorse of the belt: nothing exotic, but a fast load of everyday metal.
planet.asteroid_metallic.desc: A dense chunk of an old shattered core, its dark basalt crust scarred by craters. Bitterly cold and utterly dead — but it is nearly solid metal. Iron and titanium run everywhere, and cobalt, tungsten, platinum and neodymium wait in the deep. The richest rock a prospector can hope to land on.
planet.asteroid_icy.desc: A frozen wanderer of ice and packed snow, colder than anything with an atmosphere has any right to be. No air, no life, no sound. Metals are scarce here, but carbon, silicate, lithium and sulfur are not — the volatiles that keep a ship supplied rather than rich.
planet.asteroid_carbon.desc: A soot-dark rock so black it barely catches the starlight, riddled with caves and pitted with craters. Carbon everywhere, uranium in the depths, and diamond where the pressure once ran high. Old, primitive matter — and the likeliest place out here to find a forgotten data cache.
planet.asteroid_crystal.desc: A rare rock whose crust grew into raw crystal, glittering under the bare sun. Airless and lifeless, but extravagantly rich: crystal at the surface, then titanium, platinum, tungsten, neodymium, uranium and diamond below. Find one and mine it out — you may not see another.
block.stone.desc: The bedrock of most worlds — plentiful and sturdy, and the base for concrete and countless builds. A drill clears it quickly.
block.dirt.desc: Loose soil you can clear by hand. Grass and many plants take root on it.
block.basalt.desc: Dark volcanic rock, common on lava and ashen worlds. Tougher than ordinary stone.
block.obsidian.desc: Glassy black rock, forged where water meets lava. Extremely hard — a tier-2 drill bites, everything else just scratches.
block.ice.desc: Frozen water, slick underfoot. Clears by hand and melts near heat.
block.sand.desc: Loose grains, easy to clear by hand. Smelts into glass.
block.mud.desc: Wet, soft earth from swamps and shores. Clears by hand.
block.grass.desc: A grassy topsoil block; drops plain dirt when cleared. Plants thrive on it.
block.snow.desc: Soft snow cover on cold worlds. Clears by hand.
block.salt.desc: Crusted mineral salt from dry flats. Clears easily.
block.mycelium.desc: Living fungal soil from fungal worlds; mushrooms sprout from it.
block.alien_grass.desc: Strange ground cover from corrupted worlds, faintly aglow.
block.deepslate.desc: Dense dark rock from deep underground. Slow to mine but solid.
block.granite.desc: Hard speckled stone, tougher than ordinary rock.
block.carbon.desc: A dark, brittle mineral used to make steel and carbon composite. Found a little way down on most worlds.
block.silicate.desc: A glassy mineral, abundant just below the surface everywhere. Smelt it into glass and circuit boards.
block.crystal.desc: A glittering mineral block from crystal worlds. Harvest it for crystal, used in optics and advanced parts.
block.glass.desc: A clear pane smelted from silicate — lets light through for windows and domes.
block.ash.desc: Fine grey ash from scorched worlds. Soft and easily cleared.
block.wood_log.desc: Timber from trees; chop it for logs to craft and build with.
block.tree_leaves.desc: Leafy canopy. Clears by hand and drops nothing — handy for opening a view.
block.pine_needles.desc: Dense evergreen foliage; clears by hand and drops nothing.
block.palm_frond.desc: Broad palm foliage; clears by hand and drops nothing.
block.water.desc: Liquid water — swim through it, or scoop a block with a Tier-3 drill to carry it home.
block.lava.desc: Molten rock that burns on contact. Scoopable with a Tier-3 drill; handle with great care.
block.fire.desc: Open flame — it spreads and burns. It can't be mined; smother it or wait it out.
block.geyser_vent.desc: A steaming crack in the crust that vents hot gas. Drops basalt when mined, and tends to mark restless ground.
block.data_cache.desc: A buried, derelict storage block. Mine it to recover data fragments — the currency of the Tech tree. Rare; a scanner helps you find them.
block.force_field.desc: An impassable energy barrier — it can't be mined or broken. It marks protected ground.
block.bedrock.desc: The unbreakable floor of the world — you can't dig past it.
block.iron_ore.desc: The workhorse metal ore, found near the surface of nearly every world. Smelt it to iron, then press plates — the foundation of early tools, walls and ship parts.
block.copper_ore.desc: A common ore found shallow on most worlds. Smelt it to copper for wire and cable — your first electronics.
block.titanium_ore.desc: A tough, light metal ore that needs a Tier-2 drill. Most common on ice, crystal, ashen and asteroid worlds. Refine it into titanium plate, the backbone of bigger ships.
block.gold_ore.desc: A prized soft-metal ore set a little deeper (around 20 down). Common on rocky, desert, savanna and salt-flat worlds, and near asteroid surfaces. Smelt to gold for fine electronics.
block.silver_ore.desc: A bright, conductive ore from rocky, ice, highland and tundra worlds. Smelt to silver for circuitry.
block.aluminium_ore.desc: A light, common ore near the surface of many worlds. Smelt to aluminium and on into light alloy.
block.tin_ore.desc: A soft ore from jungle, swamp, ocean and temperate worlds. Smelt to tin and alloy it with copper into bronze.
block.nickel_ore.desc: A hard ore from cold and volcanic worlds. Smelt to nickel for tough alloys.
block.cobalt_ore.desc: A deep-blue ore needing a Tier-2 drill, found on ice, crystal, highland and tundra worlds. Smelt to cobalt for high-grade gear.
block.lithium_ore.desc: A light, reactive ore from deserts, salt flats and temperate worlds — unusually shallow on salt flats. Refine to lithium for power cells.
block.uranium_ore.desc: A heavy, radioactive ore (Tier-2 drill) buried deep on lava, crystal, ashen, corrupted and asteroid worlds. Refine to uranium for reactor fuel.
block.platinum_ore.desc: A rare noble-metal ore (Tier-2 drill) deep within lava, ashen and asteroid worlds. Refine to platinum for top-tier components.
block.lead_ore.desc: A heavy, dense ore from rocky, swamp and fungal worlds. Smelt to lead for shielding and weight.
block.zinc_ore.desc: A common ore from jungle, swamp and fungal worlds. Smelt to zinc and alloy it with copper into brass.
block.tungsten_ore.desc: An extremely hard ore (Tier-2 drill) deep on lava, crystal, ashen and asteroid worlds. Refine to tungsten for carbide and heavy tools.
block.sulfur_ore.desc: A yellow, brittle ore from desert, lava, swamp and salt-flat worlds. Used in chemistry and reactor fuel.
block.neodymium_ore.desc: A rare, magnetic ore (Tier-2 drill) deep on crystal, corrupted and asteroid worlds. Refine to neodymium for magnets and motors.
block.diamond_ore.desc: The hardest find of all (Tier-2 drill), hidden very deep — 40+ down — on lava, crystal, highland, ashen, corrupted and asteroid worlds. Cut it into diamond for the best drills and parts.
block.iron_wall.desc: A sturdy iron building block for walls and structures.
block.steel_wall.desc: A high-strength steel wall block for durable structures.
block.brass_block.desc: A decorative brass building block with a warm sheen.
block.steel_floor.desc: A clean steel floor panel for bases and ships.
block.metal_panel.desc: A plain metal wall panel — a tidy industrial finish.
block.concrete.desc: Cheap, solid building material poured from stone and sand.
block.insulated_wall.desc: A wall that holds in warmth — handy on cold or toxic worlds.
block.crate.desc: A simple storage crate — place it and stash items inside.
block.door_hinge.desc: A swinging door that opens when you interact with it.
block.door_slide.desc: A sliding door that parts when you approach or interact.
block.ladder.desc: Climbable rungs — place them to scale walls and shafts.
block.stairs.desc: A stepped block for walking up a level without jumping.
block.light_white.desc: A solid light block that glows soft white, free-standing and needing no power.
block.light_red.desc: A solid light block that glows red, free-standing and needing no power.
block.light_green.desc: A solid light block that glows green, free-standing and needing no power.
block.strip_light_cyan.desc: A bright cyan strip light that glows without power — clean station lighting.
block.strip_light_warm.desc: A warm strip light that glows without power — cosy interior lighting.
block.beam_block.desc: A glowing structural beam that throws a shaft of light.
block.radio_beacon.desc: A placeable, softly glowing beacon — a navigation landmark you can spot from afar.
block.engine_nozzle.desc: A decorative engine nozzle with a faint glow — the look of thrust.
block.medbay_panel.desc: A clinical wall panel for medbays.
block.lab_panel.desc: A laboratory wall panel for research spaces.
block.workbench.desc: Your basic crafting station — stand near it to smelt ores and build tools, parts and upgrades.
block.forge.desc: A high-heat forge that smelts ores into ingots faster and at greater yield.
block.base_core.desc: The heart of a planet base — place it to claim and protect the ground around it for you and your allies.
block.station_core.desc: The heart of an orbital station — it anchors and protects a station you build in space.
block.station_vendor.desc: A trade post where a vendor offers goods by barter. Find them in settlements and on space stations — no money, just fair swaps.
block.mission_board.desc: A job board offering an endless run of gather-and-deliver missions. Accept and turn them in right here, at settlements and stations.
block.station_container.desc: A sturdy storage container found around stations and settlements.
block.detoxifier.desc: A station that scrubs toxic air, making a sealed room breathable.
block.matter_forge.desc: The transmuter — it turns spare terrain into matter dust, and dust back into ore.
block.algae_tank.desc: A food-growing station: stand next to it to turn water into filling algae rations — the easiest food source a base can have.
block.heal_tank.desc: A soothing regeneration tank. Standing near it slowly restores health, hunger and suit energy — the heart of any base or station. Press E to set your spawn point here.
block.energy_fence.desc: A humming energy pylon. Creatures — wild, tamed and hostile alike — cannot pass it, so a ring of pylons makes a safe pen or a guarded base wall. Flying beasts glide over it.
block.energy_gate.desc: An energy membrane for fence openings: players and settlement folk walk straight through, while creatures are held back. Always on — nothing to open or close.
block.factory_terminal.desc: The control terminal of a factory. Craft its bulk recipes for free, or claim the factory as your base with an SPS access code.
block.machine_block.desc: Heavy industrial machinery — the working guts of a factory hall.
block.factory_pipe.desc: Industrial piping that runs through factory halls.
block.iron_block.desc: A solid block of refined iron — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.copper_block.desc: A solid block of refined copper — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.gold_block.desc: A solid block of refined gold — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.silver_block.desc: A solid block of refined silver — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.aluminium_block.desc: A solid block of refined aluminium — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.tin_block.desc: A solid block of refined tin — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.nickel_block.desc: A solid block of refined nickel — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.cobalt_block.desc: A solid block of refined cobalt — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.platinum_block.desc: A solid block of refined platinum — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.lead_block.desc: A solid block of refined lead — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.zinc_block.desc: A solid block of refined zinc — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.tungsten_block.desc: A solid block of refined tungsten — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.titanium_block.desc: A solid block of refined titanium — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.mushroom_stem.desc: The trunk of a giant fungus; harvest it to build with.
block.mushroom_cap.desc: The cap of a giant mushroom; yields a cap and some plant fiber.
block.flora_gasbloom.desc: A puffy bloom that holds a toxic gland inside — mind the gas.
block.flora_shardbloom.desc: A crystalline flower that breaks apart into raw crystal.
block.flora_crystal.desc: A cultivated crystal growth; harvest it for crystal.
block.flora_glowcap.desc: A glowing cap that yields plant fiber and a shard of crystal.
block.flora_glowvine.desc: A luminous vine that yields plant fiber and a shard of crystal.
block.flora_sporepod.desc: A bulging spore pod; yields plant fiber and a shard of crystal.
block.flora_coral.desc: Stony underwater coral that breaks into crystal.
block.flora_frostflower.desc: A hardy frost bloom that breaks into crystal.
block.flora_emberbloom.desc: A hardy bloom of burning worlds that breaks into crystal.
block.flora_cinderbush.desc: A scorched shrub that yields plant fiber and a shard of crystal.
block.flora_bush.desc: A leafy bush that yields edible berries and plant fiber.
block.flora_bulb.desc: A swollen alien bulb that yields plant fiber and a few berries.
block.flora_flower.desc: A bright flower that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_lily.desc: A floating lily that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_orchid.desc: A delicate orchid that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_succulent.desc: A water-storing succulent; yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_pitcher.desc: A pitcher plant that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_bellflower.desc: A nodding bellflower that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_rockflower.desc: A rugged rock flower that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_snowbush.desc: A snow-dusted bush that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_tendril.desc: A wispy alien tendril; cut it for plant fiber.
block.flora_alienfern.desc: A large alien fern, a generous source of plant fiber.
block.flora_plant.desc: A cultivated plant that yields plant fiber and a berry.
block.flora_fern.desc: A leafy fern; cut it for plant fiber.

ui.bandit.title: Hold-up
ui.bandit.countdown: Answer within {0} s — staying silent counts as refusing.
ui.bandit.hint: Pay and they leave you alone. Refuse and they will fight.
ui.bandit.paid: You handed over the goods. The bandit keeps its word and moves on.
ui.bandit.refused: You refused — now it means trouble!
ui.bandit.expired: No answer — the bandit takes that as a no. Trouble!
bandit.line.holdup1: Easy there, traveler! Toll time — hand over a little of that heavy pack and nobody gets hurt.
bandit.line.holdup2: Nice haul you're carrying. Share a bit of it and we part as friends, hm?
bandit.line.holdup3: Stop right there! This is my patch — passage costs you. Pay up and walk on.
bandit.line.hail1: Attention, freighter! This is pirate space. Transfer a share of your cargo and fly on undisturbed.
bandit.line.hail2: Well well, a lone ship in our sector. A small toll and we never met, deal?
bandit.line.hail3: Your hold looks heavy, captain. Lighten it for us and keep your hull in one piece.
